title: IVG Pro Salts Banana Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Pro Nic Salts Banana Ice 10ml E-Liquid delivers a smooth and deeply satisfying tropical vaping experience. This expertly balanced profile captures the rich, creamy sweetness of a ripe Banana, providing a velvety and authentic fruit inhale. To complement the initial warmth, a crisp layer of Ice on the exhale delivers a refreshing, frosty finish. This perfectly contrasts the sweet fruit notes, creating a highly well-rounded and deeply enjoyable all-day vape. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. IVG Pro Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits, serving as a highly cost-effective alternative to single-use or prefilled systems. The IVG Pro Salts collection takes the globally revered flavour profiles from the beloved IVG Pro prefilled pod range and makes them available in convenient 10ml bottles. As a multi-award-winning UK brand, IVG ensures exceptional quality across a massive selection of e-liquids. Beyond the creamy chill of Banana Ice, vapers can explore other standout blends such as the nostalgic Cola GB or the sharply refreshing Blackberry Sour Razz, ensuring a premium option for every palate.
